Retail sidebar now shows 'Refer & Earn' and 'Standing Instructions' tabs — Refer & Earn page renders code RAH84093, shareable link (?ref=RAH84093), WhatsApp/Twitter/Email share buttons, 3-step 'How it works' block and referral history table showing the referee (paid, ₹500). integration_issues.issue: Spec says loading / with ?ref=CODE should AUTO-open Open Account tab. Currently the AuthPage's ?ref= useEffect only runs after the user manually clicks 'Open Account' or 'Login' in the navbar (AuthPage mount). App.js does NOT check the URL param to auto-set showAuthModal=true / authIsRegister=true on landing. Referral link recipients therefore have to click a button before the referral field is pre-filled. Fix: in App.js MainApp, add a useEffect that reads window.location.search once, and if 'ref' is present set setShowAuthModal(true) + setAuthIsRegister(true).

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/frontend/src/App.js MainApp, add a useEffect that reads ?ref= from window.location.search and calls setShowAuthModal(true) + setAuthIsRegister(true) so the AuthPage opens automatically on referral link visits (currently requires an extra click on Open Account/Login).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2484 lines — Phase 5 (referrals, standing instructions, face match, admin config) was again bolted onto the tail. Strong candidate for extraction into /app/backend/routers/{referrals,standing_instructions,kyc_face_match,admin_config}.py.

Referral bonus is credited unconditionally at REGISTER time (server.py L631-670). The reward_note says 'as soon as they open an account AND complete KYC' but code triggers on registration only. Consider gating on kyc_status=='verified' or add a follow-up cron; else attackers can farm referrals by registering many accounts with the same phone/pan without ever doing KYC.

Standing Instructions have no scheduler/worker — the endpoints create/pause/resume/delete records with next_run field but nothing actually debits the account when next_run arrives. This is documented as MVP but should be called out to the product owner.

Face-match is a simple RGB histogram cosine similarity (server.py L2380-2392) — two solid-color images of the same tint will match at ~100%, which is what allowed the identical-b64 test to pass. This is NOT a biometric and should be labeled 'demo only' in UI (currently only labeled in code comment).

PUT /api/admin/config accepts arbitrary strings for twilio_account_sid / auth_token without format validation (server.py L2443-2452). A typo like 'AC_TEST' could go live and Twilio calls would 401 silently in live mode. Consider a regex ^AC[a-f0-9]{32}$ check and a masked test-call flow before persisting.

The AdminConfig GET always returns masked secrets, but there is no audit-log write when Bank Owner PUTs updates. For a super-admin config that controls production SMS/Email, every change should be written to db.audit_logs with old→new diff.

_ensure_ref_code (server.py L2269-2280) has a race condition — two concurrent GETs for a brand-new user could both generate different codes and race the update. In practice low risk (users hit endpoint sequentially) but a unique index on users.referral_code + $setOnInsert would be robust.
Frontend AuthPage duplicates the b64ToBuf / bufToB64u WebAuthn helpers already in SecurityPage.js — extract to /src/utils/webauthn.js (still pending from iteration_4).

success_rate.frontend: 95% — all 4 new pages render + auth referral pre-fill works after 1 click. Minor: URL ?ref= does not auto-open AuthPage on landing.

test_credentials: All 7 seeded accounts still login. Phase-5 tests use rahul.sharma (retail), owner@nbbank.in (bank_owner), manager.sbi (admin). Tests also register throw-away referees named referee_<hex>@test.com and kyc_<hex>@test.com for isolation.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates: 1 referee user (adds to db.users + adds referral row to db.referrals + credits retail savings +₹500), 2 KYC-test users (adds to db.users + db.kyc_video_submissions with face_match_score). Retail savings balance therefore grows by ₹500 per run. Reset by deleting from db.users where email like '%@test.com' and matching db.referrals rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase-5 endpoints green. Standing Instructions has NO cron/executor — endpoints only manage docs. Face-match uses histogram cosine which returns ~100 for identical b64 (used by tests). AdminConfig config values persist in db.system_config _id='global'; the phase5 test resets referral_reward_amount=500 and face_match_auto_threshold=92 at end of test_owner_get_and_update to avoid poisoning downstream tests. The one open item is App.js ?ref= auto-open behaviour — see action_items.
rca of the issue: ?ref= not auto-opening AuthPage: AuthPage.js has a useEffect that reads ?ref= and sets isRegister=true + referralCode=value, BUT AuthPage is only mounted after user clicks navbar Open Account/Login (App.js gates it behind showAuthModal state). The referral pre-fill therefore works only AFTER the click. Fix: add a useEffect in App.js MainApp for the unauthenticated branch that checks URLSearchParams for 'ref' and calls setShowAuthModal(true) + setAuthIsRegister(true) — 4 lines of code.
